title: Rustavi sweep Griffin to conquer A League title
description: Griffin - Rustavi 100-102 Rustavi swept Griffin in the championship series and clinched Superleague promotion. The guests trailed by 14 points after first quarter, but they rallied back and won the game by 2 points. Rustavi made 25-of-32 free shots (78.1 percent) during the game. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 23 assists. 28 personal fouls committed by Griffin helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. It was a good game for American point guard Malik Tidwell (180-2001, college: Georgia South) who led his team to a victory with 24 points and 8 assists (on 9-of-10 shooting from the field). Forward Guga Patashuri (201-1998) contributed with 23 points for the winners. Four Rustavi players scored in double figures.
